verdict.rationale: Featurebase shows a public roadmap built from voted feedback (docs-15, docs-19). It also automatically notifies users when their requests ship (docs-12), which implies requests are tied to roadmap status and shipped items. No evidence shows explicitly linking feedback to discrete roadmap features, initiatives, or changelog releases. Missing for 10: explicit feedback-to-feature linking, any initiative/epic hierarchy, explicit linking of requests to changelog releases, in-depth docs or hands-on corroboration.
